metatext.metatext:experimental_procedure: To isolate crude mitochondria, freshly collected TA muscle samples were washed once in cold PBS and incubated in 4 mL Mito buffer A (220 mM mannitol, 70 mM sucrose, 20 mM HEPES/KOH, 0.5 mM PMSF, 2 mg/mL BSA, 1 mM EDTA/Tris pH 7.4) supplemented with protease and phosphatase inhibitors on ice. The tissues were homogenized in a motor-driven potter (20 strokes, 1000 rpm) and cell debris was pelleted at 800 g for 5 min at 4 °C. The supernatant was collected, the pellet was subjected to a second homogenization (20 strokes, 1000 rpm), centrifuged at 800 g for 5 min at 4 °C, the supernatant was combined with the supernatant from the first homogenization, and centrifuged at 8000 g for 5 min at 4 °C. The supernatant was discarded and the pellet was resuspended in 1 mL Mito buffer B (220 mM mannitol, 70 mM sucrose, 20 mM HEPES/KOH, 0.5 mM PMSF, 1 mM EDTA/Tris pH 7.4), centrifuged twice at 8000 g for 5 min at 4 °C and the mitochondrial pellet was resuspended in 1 mL buffer B. Finally, the samples were centrifuged at 10,000 g for 5 min at 4 °C and the mitochondria were resuspended in 300–500 μL Mito buffer B. \nSamples from subcellular fractionation were prepared for MS analysis by in-solution digestion. Urea-containing samples were reduced by adding DTT at a final concentration of 5 mM for 1 h at RT. Alkylation with IAA at a final concentration of 40 mM was performed for 30 min in the dark at RT. Next, the samples were digested with 1 μL LysC for 2–3 h at RT. Finally, the samples were diluted with 50 mM ABC to a urea concentration of 2 M and incubated with 1 μL 0.5 mg/mL trypsin overnight at RT, acidified to 1% FA and purified on StageTips.
